# ECC plugin (vendored snapshot)

This directory contains a **vendored snapshot** of the
[Everything Claude Code (ECC)](https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC) plugin,
included in ai-os as reference material and as the source for selective
adoption of agents, skills, hooks, commands, rules and schemas.

| Field         | Value                                  |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Source repo   | https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC        |
| Version       | 2.0.0                                  |
| License       | MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Affaan Mustafa) |
| Date vendored | 2026-06-28                             |

See `VENDORED_FROM.md` for full provenance, contents listing, update
procedure, and license obligations.

The upstream `.git/`, `.github/`, `node_modules/`, `.cache/` and `dist/`
directories are intentionally excluded. Everything else from the upstream
snapshot is included verbatim.
